lf: LF: To identify which operation a word problem needs and explain why.
ican1: I can identify which operation a problem needs and explain why.
ican2: I can find the signal word or key structure that tells me the operation.

lf: LF: To solve word problems by identifying the operation first, then calculating.
ican1: I can follow the two-step routine: identify the operation, then calculate.
ican2: I can solve word problems using all four operations.

lf: LF: To plan and solve two-step problems using a bar model.
ican1: I can use a bar model to plan a two-step problem before calculating.
ican2: I can identify the operation for each step and work through them in the right order.

lf: LF: To solve problems in money and measurement contexts by choosing the right operation.
ican1: I can solve money and measurement problems by identifying the correct operation.
ican2: I can include the correct unit in every answer.
